reason: I have paid creators before and got nothing, so a promo code that shows me how many customers actually came is exactly what I am missing. It is free in the pilot, so I would try one small deal with a Verified creator and see the count myself.
objection: Self-reported numbers are what burned me last time, and once the pilot ends 10% plus GST on every deal adds up when my margins are this thin. Also, if my staff forget to tap +1 at the counter, the numbers are useless.
would_change_my_mind: If the first creator brings fewer customers than the fee was worth, I will not do a second deal, free or not.
